en.needsAllowBuilds: This plugin installs from GitHub, and pnpm blocks a git-hosted package's build script until you allow it. Run the install once in a terminal u2014 `dsh plugin --profile web add <source>` u2014 and pnpm prints the exact key to add under `allowBuilds` in ~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml. Plugins published to npm install here without that step.
